name: Lonebrow's Journal
summary: At the base of the Great Lift, Henrig Lonebrow's journal records his final journey. He crossed the Barrens as danger gathered at Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Dying Wish at the Great Lift
sections.body:
Henrig Lonebrow died near the base of the Great Lift, the passage between the Barrens and Thousand Needles. His bones rest on a rocky ledge with the weathered journal still in his grasp.

The pages recount his last travels and ask the finder to carry word to Falfindel Waywarder, a night elf druid at Thalanaar. The outpost lies on the border of Feralas. Lonebrow's notes warn of the quilboar threat growing in the southern Barrens.

sections.title: Ties to the Razorfen
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder receives records that confirm the Alliance's fears about the quilboar of Razorfen Kraul. Lonebrow's account calls for a strike at the heart of the thorny warren. Charlga Razorflank, the Crone of the Kraul, directs the threat.

faq.answer: Henrig Lonebrow was a dwarven traveler who died at the foot of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. His journal remained in his hand, meant to carry his account to the night elves at Thalanaar.
The journal lies beside Henrig Lonebrow's skeleton, on a low rocky ledge just off the ramp at the base of the Great Lift in northern Thousand Needles.

aliases: who do i bring journal to
faq.answer: Carry Lonebrow's Journal west across Thousand Needles to Falfindel Waywarder, a night elf druid at Thalanaar on the border of Feralas.

faq.q: What does the journal lead to?
faq.answer: The journal brings Falfindel Waywarder word of the quilboar. Its account calls for a strike on Razorfen Kraul and Charlga Razorflank.

angles.text: Finding a fallen dwarf in these remote, hostile lands reminds you of the dangers dwarven explorers face far from Khaz Modan.
Henrig Lonebrow's last writings link Alliance scouts with the druids guarding the border to Feralas. They bring aid against the quilboar threat.
